findings.detail: WI-1 places the new near parameter BETWEEN query and serverKey: SuggestAsync(string query, (double Lat, double Lng)? near, string? serverKey, CancellationToken ct). Mid-signature insertion, so EVERY positional call site breaks at compile time. Confirmed sites all in files_touched: MapyClient.cs (impl), GeoService.cs:31 + closure at :40, MapyClientHandlerTests.cs (5 calls), FakeMapyClient/CountingMapyClient nested in GeoServiceTests.cs. Coverage-complete per grep — flagged LOW only to make explicit all 5 MapyClientHandlerTests calls must gain near: null.
findings.suggested_fix: No change needed; the WI enumerates every call site. Developer updates all 5 MapyClientHandlerTests.SuggestAsync calls with positional near (e.g. SuggestAsync("Praha", near: null, TestKey, ct)). ALSO edit the IMapyClient.cs interface itself (it is in required_reads + AC#1 changes its signature, even though files_touched shows MapyClient.cs as the edit locus).

verified_not_findings.detail: COORDINATE-ORDER CORRECTNESS (highest risk) CORRECT + consistent at every hop. Frontend getGeoSuggest emits near={lat},{lng}. SuggestEndpoint.cs:71-74 parses parts[0]=lat, parts[1]=lng into (Lat,Lng). GeoService forwards the tuple unchanged on both paths. MapyClient flips ONCE to preferNear={lng},{lat}, mirroring existing RouteAsync start={fromLng},{fromLat} (MapyClient.cs:88-90). Pinned by value assertions: frontend near=50.09,14.43 (lat-first); backend preferNear=14.43,50.08 (lng-first). A silent swap moves bias to open sea and is caught.

Mapy preferNear treated as BEST-EFFORT: preferNear + preferNearPrecision=5000 flagged provisional/verify-vs-live-docs (MapyConstants/UC-010 WI-09 precedent); real gate is URL present/absent + coord-order + dot-decimal test, not the exact param name. InvariantCulture mandated + pinned by the never-comma assertion.

GeoService forwards near on BOTH paths (line 31 Guid.Empty bypass + line 40 cache-miss factory closure); pinned per-path via FakeMapyClient.LastSuggestNear. Cache key unchanged (already includes near).

Signature-change completeness verified by grep. MapyClient the only production implementer. FakeMapyClient gains LastSuggestNear; CountingMapyClient signature-only (both nested in GeoServiceTests.cs). FakeGeoService correctly NOT touched (implements IGeoService whose SuggestAsync already carries near). Developer MUST also edit IMapyClient.cs interface.

Frontend location-selection sound: pickSuggestLocation pure (mapCenter -> GPS -> configCenter -> null) with 2-decimal (~1.1km) coarse rounding INSIDE the helper (coarser than client.ts roundCoord 4-decimal). useSuggest keys on ['geo','suggest',debounced,near] so coarse-near change re-queries, equal does not. GPS tier supplied null by MapOrderPage = documented deliberate placeholder, not a gap.
Referenced frontend surfaces exist: LatLng {lat,lng} in shell/mapCamera.ts; GeoConfigResponse mapCenterLat/mapCenterLng; MapOrderPage owns pendingCenter + useGeoConfig. No memoization added.

AC#1 (Prague above Kolin) not an untested gap: re-ranking is Mapy-side, no e2e by design (ranking not flow/DOM change). Maps to backend preferNear URL test + frontend near-send + useSuggest re-query tests. Complete at every testable layer.

Cross-feature import cleared: suggestLocation.ts imports LatLng from shell/mapCamera (declared 'Exported for UC-015/016/019'; MapOrderPage already imports it). customer/ is the feature boundary, shell/ the shared shell. Consistent with precedent.

No route/verb/policy/result-shape change; rate limiter, key-missing short-circuit, GeoResult.Unavailable degradation untouched; lenient near-parse unchanged; per-location caching kept. No new i18n string.
Topology acyclic (WI-1 -> WI-2); lanes correct (WI-1 api, WI-2 web); test-ordering follows the ladder; AC#5 both-lane gates present, no e2e (justified); no architecture-ban violations.
